projects.name: roost
projects.description: A game-server control panel for the case the field ignores: N servers on one box. systemd owns every process; roost observes and never guesses where a dbus signal already exists. Five servers live across four config backends and two installers.

projects.name: wake
projects.description: A market-data recorder and paper-trading harness. The venue serves no historical positions and caps fills per wallet, so the recorded dataset is irreplaceable and downtime is permanent loss — which is the constraint the whole design answers to.

projects.name: tyco-home
projects.description: A live network diagram assembled from metrics, BMC sensors and service probes. The backend sends raw state and counters; the browser derives every rendered word, so a rule change is a page edit with an instant visual check instead of a redeploy.

projects.name: tyco.sh
projects.description: This site. A page and a small API, served from the edge, fed by a snapshot the network pushes outward — so nothing public ever reaches the house and a dark house degrades to an honest 'no data' rather than a timeout.
